reserveReview.reviewer: SONG-2 Safety Score V9 reserve review
reserveReview.rationale: The eurSPKCC public API publishes aggregate share-class assets and NAV, not a constituent allocation. Spiko's stakeholder documentation identifies Marex as the structured-note counterparty and CACEIS Bank as custodian and depositary. The reviewed 100% strategy row remains a conservative aggregate envelope because no current constituent positions or Treasury/cash weights were obtained; the previously unsupported 80/20 split is not restored.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Current Spiko eurSPKCC share-class API snapshot and product documentation
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: Marex is the disclosed structured-note counterparty and CACEIS Bank the disclosed custodian and depositary. Current constituent positions, look-through digital-asset weights, and any internal cash or Treasury allocation remain undisclosed.

nonLinkDispositions.rationale: Spiko exposes the live strategy category but does not publish the current constituent positions or weights needed for tracked dependency mapping.
